title: Duck Wing with Asian Seasonings and Goat Cheese Poppers
htmlIngredientLines: 2 scallions, trimmed, white parts cut into 1-inch pieces and crushed with the blade of a chef’s knife, green parts thinly sliced and reserved for a garnish
1-1/2 inches fresh ginger, sliced into thin coins (no need to peel)
1 tablespoon Thai sweet chili sauce, or more to taste
1 tablespoon honey, or more to taste
